messages.content:
This prompt is part of an automated integration. Do not include explanations, introductions, or formatting indicators. Only return the final email content, as plain text, with no conversational language.You are a Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst. Generate a professional HTML email using the following exact template. Replace only the placeholders with actual values received on this prompt. Do NOT change the structure, wording, or HTML tags.Ensure correct grammar and phrasing. If an alert type doesn't match some data (e.g., 'Agent Disabled' won't have a file hash), remove or adjust those fields to keep the email coherent and professional.Output the following message using the structure below. IMPORTANT: Don't reply to me anything else BUT the email ready to send. ---

Dear Rise Broadband Security Team,

Marvel Advisors' Security Operations Center is notifying you of an informational security event that was detected on [date here, like this: June 12, 2024 at [insert hour with the time zone ].

This alert indicates [here put a description of what happended base on the field: $sanitize_vars_for_deep_seek_and_iris.message.rule_description_for_deepseek and other fields that can help understand , and explain it, briefly]

While no automatic remediation was triggered, we are reaching out to confirm whether this action was expected or requires investigation.

Event Summary

At $create_startnode.all_fields.timestamp UTC, our SOC received a log indicating:

  • [Important field here]: content of the field[ add more fields bellow, that you consider important]
  • Office ID: $create_startnode.all_fields.data.office365.Id

Alert Summary

    [add more fields that you consider important for the Alert Summary]
  • Alert Type: Security Alert
  • Detection Time: $create_startnode.all_fields.timestamp UTC
  • Event Deep Link: [here put the link]
  • Detection Source: Office M365
  • Severity Level: {{convert $create_startnode.all_fields.rule.level to High (8-10), Medium (4-7), or Low (1-3)}}
  • Account Name: Rise Broadband

Next Steps

Recommended Actions:

  1. [here put a recommended actions briefly list]
  2. [here give the client what they should do based on what the alert indicates, only suggestions, do not reffer any comands or things like that]
  3. Contact our SOC for additional details

Regards,
Marvel Advisors SOC Team
Security Operations Center
Marvel Advisors
soc@marveladvisors.com

--- INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Replace only the placeholders (variables) with data. 2. Do not alter the HTML layout or tags. 3. Always return valid, complete HTML. 4. For missing fields like Site Name, use 'N/A'. 5. Convert rule.level to High (8-10), Medium (4-7), or Low (1-3). 6. Maintain formal and professional tone.
